content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E017 (Jennifer Miller) requests write access to Source Code.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR/team): role Analyst, full_time, recommends write. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin only for Engineer role.
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst (not looked up), employment type contractor (looked up in own database), security training basic, recommends read. Security DB shows contractor with basic training; contractors max read without advanced training.

Conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. Security DB is authoritative according to Note 2. So employment type = contractor, security training = basic.

Policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. This contractor has basic training, so max = read.

Requested level = write, which is above max (read). So grant the maximum = read.

Never grant more than requested. Read is below write anyway.

Decision: read.
